scripts.publish-history: npx tfx-cli extension create --manifests ./variable-group-history.vss.json && npx tfx-cli extension publish --manifests ./variable-group-history.vss.json --rev-version --token $ADS_MKT_PAT && rm *.vsix
scripts.publish-pipeline: npx tfx-cli extension create --manifests ./pipeline-profiles.vss.json && npx tfx-cli extension publish --manifests ./pipeline-profiles.vss.json --rev-version --token $ADS_MKT_PAT && rm *.vsix
scripts.start-history-dev: npm run dev:cert && ng serve azure-devops-variable-group-editor --configuration development --host localhost --port 4300 --ssl --ssl-cert .certs/localhost.pem --ssl-key .certs/localhost-key.pem
scripts.start-pipeline-dev: npm run dev:cert && ng serve azure-devops-pipeline-profiles --configuration development --host localhost --port 4301 --ssl --ssl-cert .certs/localhost.pem --ssl-key .certs/localhost-key.pem
scripts.pack-dev: npm run pack-history-dev && npm run pack-pipeline-dev
